    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 4
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m330_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m330_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_route_code value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_affected_character_count value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_target_role_count value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_training_days value = 90 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_assessment_score value = 50 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_threshold value = 70 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_placed value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_failed_is_low_grade value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_fairness_debt value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_role_identity_conserved value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m330_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_route_code value = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_fairness_debt value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m330_placed }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m330_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m330_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 330 learning.settle_reskill_route"
    }
}

# 330 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m330_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 330 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m330_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m330_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m330_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m330_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 330 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 330 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_reskill_assessment_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m330_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m330_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 330 reskill_case obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m330_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m330_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 331 learning.borrow_protected_time
zg361_cl_m331_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            OR = {
                liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
                AND = {
                    # AH and AI cases open in parallel.  Once #319 really
                    # moves the subject, both frozen cases may finish only
                    # under this exact settled vacancy/title postcondition.
                    var:zg361_transfer_consumer_kind = 2
                    var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status = 3
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_phase = 6
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_subject = this
                    liege = var:zg361_transfer_cl_receiver
                    primary_title = var:zg361_transfer_cl_title
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_title = { holder = this }
                }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = {
                                        OR = {
                                            scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                                            scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                                        }
                                    }
                                    OR = {
                                        is_at_war = yes
                                        var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { is_at_war = yes }
                                    }
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m331_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 331
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_kind_id value = 20 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_capacity_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m331_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_learner value = var:zg361_cl_m331_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_days value = 365 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.831 days = 365 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_days value = 365 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.831 days = 365 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_days value = 365 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.831 days = 365 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m331_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 331 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 331 } }
    }
}

# 331 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m331_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 4
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m331_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_total_capacity value = 100 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_protected_hours value = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_borrowed_hours value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_delivery_hours value = 94 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_real_crisis_required value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_repayment_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_repaid_hours value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_manager_score_delta value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_capacity_conserved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m331_manager_score_delta }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 331 learning.borrow_protected_time"
    }
}

# 331 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m331_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m331_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 331 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_protected_time_repayment_checked value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_repaid_hours value = 4 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m331_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_manager_score_delta value = -10 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m331_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_debt_overdue value = 1 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m331_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }

            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }

            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 331 protected_time_loan obligation"
    }
}

    zg361_cl_m331_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}
